preprocess.resize_note: downscale with an ANTIALIASED BILINEAR (triangle) filter as in training (torchvision antialias / PIL BILINEAR); box/area filters shift the centre by px

center.meaning: normalized (x, y) in [0, 1]; multiply by source width/height

heatmap.meaning: spatial probability of the centre at 1/4 input resolution (row-major, sums to 1); center is its expectation
